title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 33. Takes note of the human rights and democracy-related objectives in all pillars of the proposed Global Europe instrument and the proposed increase in EU funding for external action; recalls, however, that the EU’s democratisation assistance programmes for countries across the world have rarely led to any serious improvement in the local situation; notes, moreover, that the massive flows of official EU development aid have had negative effects on the broader state and democracy-building process in many developing countries;
